title: Mechanistic and signal engineering of nitrogen-doped MXene quantum dots in electrochemical and electrochemiluminescence sensing platforms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22806-22828
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01114D, Review Article
Enas Daoud, Entidhar Jasim Mohammed, Roopashree R, Subhashree Ray, Baraa Mohammed Yaseen, Kavitha V, Renu Sharma, Aashna Sinha, Hadi Noorizadeh
N-doped MXene quantum dots enable tunable electronic structure and enhanced electrochemical and ECL responses. This review links doping-dependent mechanisms with signal engineering strategies for advanced sensing applications.
